response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.circuitId AS circuitId, ci.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY ci.circuitId, ci.country), a AS (SELECT country, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c GROUP BY country) SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, c.cnt AS race_count, c.cnt * 1.0 / a.avg_cnt AS ratio FROM c JOIN a ON c.country = a.country ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
